faqs.question: Will every stain disappear?
faqs.answer: Results vary by stain, fibre, age and prior treatments; complete removal cannot be guaranteed.

faqs.question: How long will it take to dry?
faqs.answer: Drying depends on fabric, weather, airflow and treatment. Confirm the estimate when booking.

faqs.question: Do you clean delicate fabrics?
faqs.answer: Please provide fabric details first so suitability can be assessed.
